name: Graphite
tagline: AI code review and stacked pull requests for fast-moving engineering teams.
description: Graphite is a code-review platform built around stacked pull requests and Diamond, an AI reviewer that comments on PRs with senior-engineer rigor — catching bugs, style issues, and architectural concerns. It layers a merge queue, a CLI, a VS Code extension, and a collaborative review interface on top of GitHub-based workflows, and now runs agents directly inside the PR.
insight: Raised a $52M Series B led by Accel (with Anthropic and Sequoia backing) and launched its Diamond AI reviewer in 2025.
edge: Pairs stacked pull requests with Diamond, an AI reviewer tuned to comment with senior-engineer rigor rather than nitpicks.
